title: 提交者身份的界定标准
issue: 手册以写权界定提交者：“The committers are the people who have push access to the Git repository”，并另列“Anyone can submit a bug to the Bug Database”，仅报缺陷者与提交者由此分开。

title: 贡献者与开发者的层级差
issue: 手册述开发模型为“a loose set of concentric circles”，贡献文章称“A large and growing number of international contributors, of greatly varying ages and areas of technical expertise, develop FreeBSD.”，层级与人口特征均有着落。

title: 用户作为开发者来源的位次
issue: 手册“the largest group of developers are the users themselves who provide feedback and bug fixes to us on an almost constant basis”，直证用户居开发者群体之首。

title: NetBSD 的人员类别编制
issue: NetBSD 人员页称开发者具“CVS commit privileges”，名单内标 core、board、membership-exec、releng 等身份；基金会页列执行委员会；ports/amd64 页另设 port maintainer 信箱，开发者、核心组、基金会、移植维护者四类可核。

title: 身份称谓与权限的对应层级
issue: Apache 页“The meritocracy typically has various roles within each individual Apache project community”，依次列 user、developer、committer、PMC member、PMC chair、ASF member，各级权责分述。

title: 提交位的授予与范围指定
issue: 提交者指南“When FreeBSD commit bits are allocated, the areas of the tree where the bit may be used are specified.”

title: 提交位作为写权限的实质
issue: Apache 页“A committer is a developer who has write access to the code repository”，以写权而非头衔定义。

title: 权限范围与仓库分界的对应
issue: 指南“the areas associated with a bit reflect who authorized the allocation of the commit bit”，并说明新增领域须另走授予程序，可见范围与树域对应、跨域另授。

title: 增设权限领域的审批路径
issue: 指南“Additional areas of authority may be added at a later date ... seeking approval from the appropriate entity”，扩权重走同一程序。

title: 提交位的公开名单与规模
issue: DragonFly 团队页设“Committers”一节公开列名与信箱规则，另列 additional contributors；该页自注“may be incomplete”，故规模可清点而名录未必完备。

title: 新提交者的提名与审批流程
issue: 指南“finding a mentor who will propose them to srcmgr, doceng, or portmgr, as appropriate”；管理页 Accounts Team 条款称开户须“proper approval from the appropriate entity”，提名、核准、开户三步俱全。

title: 申请程序的书面化要求
issue: NetBSD 开发者文档页首列“New NetBSD developer application procedure”与“Commit Guidelines”，申请与提交俱有成文程序。

title: 导师提名在新人准入中的作用
issue: 指南以“finding a mentor who will propose them”为取得追加提交位之正途，导师提名即准入枢纽。

title: 招募渠道的开放与集中
issue: 手册称基金会以“workshops, educational material, and presentations”及技术会议招募，而开户核准权归 Accounts Team，开放渠道与集中核准并存。

title: 入门门槛的技术与时间成本
issue: GSoC 页“participating in Google Summer of Code is a significant time commitment”，且工期自 8 至 22 周，时间成本即实际门槛。

title: 导师责任的书面规定
issue: 指南“A mentor is responsible for teaching the mentee the rules and conventions of the project and guiding their first steps in the developer community.”

title: 导师对受导者行为的担保
issue: 指南“The mentor is also personally responsible for the mentee's actions during this initial period”，责任随人。

title: 受导期提交须经批准
issue: 指南“For committers: do not commit anything without first getting mentor approval.”，并要求以 Approved by 行留痕。

title: 导师制的解除与自主提交
issue: 指南“the mentor announces it with a commit to mentors”，该文件在 admin orphan branch，以提交宣告出师。

title: 功劳制晋升的对照对象
issue: Apache 页“A PMC member is a committer who was elected due to merit for the evolution of the project”，选举晋升与导师担保可相对照。

title: 非平凡改动的审阅义务
issue: 指南“All non-trivial changes should be reviewed before they are committed to the repository.”

title: 审阅渠道的公开取向
issue: 指南“Reviews may be conducted by email, in Bugzilla, in Phabricator, or by another mechanism. Where possible, reviews should be public.”

title: 审阅循环中的明确同意
issue: 指南称“Code review can be an iterative process, which continues until the patch is ready to be committed”，并明确要求收到认可语句后方得提交。

title: 审阅不可由超时替代
issue: 指南“Timeouts are not a substitute for review.”

title: 审查者的专业资格限定
issue: 指南“while anyone is welcome to review and give feedback on a patch, only an appropriate subject-matter expert can approve a change”。

title: 暂停权限的临时决定权
issue: 指南“Individual members of core have the power to temporarily suspend commit privileges until core as a whole has the chance to review the issue.”

title: 长期停权所需的表决门槛
issue: 指南“Only a 2/3 majority of core has the authority to suspend commit privileges for longer than a week or to remove them permanently.”

title: 紧急处置中的仓库管理员角色
issue: 指南以提交者损坏仓库的紧急情形为条件，允许 repository meisters 先行“a temporary suspension”。

title: 被停权者的听证权利
issue: 指南载被停权者有权由核心组听证，且“the total duration of the suspension being determined at that time”。

title: 撤销后的复核间隔
issue: 指南“A committer whose privileges have been revoked entirely may request a review after a period of 6 months has elapsed.”，与停权满 30 日可请复核并列为两级间隔。

title: 核心团队驱逐成员的票数门槛
issue: 现行章程“Core members and committers may be ejected by a 2/3 vote of core.”

title: 维护领域的责任归属
issue: 指南“When modifying parts of the system which are maintained, formally or informally, consider asking for a review”，并指 MAINTAINERS 文件定位责任区。

title: 团队章程的批准层级
issue: portmgr 页“Discusses the goals, rights, and responsibilities of the team. The contents of this document are approved by the FreeBSD Core Team.”

title: 局部自治与核心团队的位阶
issue: 管理页称核心组“responsible for deciding the project's overall goals and direction”；portmgr 等团队就其所辖领域自订政策。

title: 维护者名单的公开渠道
issue: portmgr 页 Team Members 节列“portmgr@FreeBSD.org: Mathieu Arnold”，管理页各团队亦均列公开别名与成员名单。

title: 领域自治的边界与例外
issue: 指南列“These changes do not require review or approval from a committer in the target repository”，其外则“should seek review from committers with the appropriate bit in the target repository”。

title: 受雇开发者的参与动因
issue: Producing OSS“a company needs a particular piece of software to be maintained and developed, and does not need monopoly control of that software”，并言独占反使维护负担独归一家。

title: 企业支持与项目信誉的联动
issue: 同章“When a large company visibly backs an open source project, people assume the project will receive adequate support in its early stages”，信誉之传染由此可证。

title: 独立开发者的位置与留存
issue: 同章“they'll leave for a project that seems more like a meritocracy and less like unpaid labor for someone else's benefit”。

title: 雇员身份在决策中的换算
issue: 同章“the weight given to your company's goals will be determined by its representatives' status in the project, rather than by your company's size, budget, or business plan”。

title: 企业开发团队的商业角色
issue: Klara 首页自述“Klara is at the intersection of enterprise and open source”，以 FreeBSD 与 ZFS 的开发及支持服务对外供给，属项目之外并行的商业实体。

title: 无偿劳动的份额与表述
issue: Producing OSS“most free software is written by paid developers, not by volunteers”。

title: 薪酬对响应速度的影响
issue: 同章“Having paid developers means that bug reports are more likely to be listened to, that needed work is more likely to get done”。

title: 志愿者的动机与持续投入
issue: OpenBSD FAQ“The maintainers of OpenBSD support the project largely from their own pockets.”

title: 受雇与志愿的混合编制
issue: 手册“most members of the core team are also volunteers when it comes to FreeBSD development and do not benefit from the project financially”。

title: 捐助与劳动的替代关系
issue: 贡献文章以捐款、捐硬件、捐时间并列为参与方式，另设“Donating Funds”与“Donating Hardware”两节；OpenBSD FAQ 亦并陈捐款与时间技能。

title: 活跃贡献者的时间口径
issue: 新章程“has committed to the main branch of the src, ports or doc repositories in the last twelve months”。

title: 表决权与提交位的绑定
issue: 新章程“Any Active Contributor, and only Active Contributors, may vote in a Core Team Election.”

title: 成员资格在法人层面的延伸
issue: 基金会章程定义“A Member of the Foundation is a developer who has signed the NetBSD Project Development agreement”，“Active Member”另须十二月内提交；人员页亦称开发者即基金会成员。会员资格确系开发身份在法人层面的延伸，切片 thesis 作“并行”，宜改写为“派生”。

title: 会员身份与开发身份的错位
issue: Apache 页“An ASF member is a person who was nominated by current members and elected due to merit for the evolution and progress of the foundation”，且“Members care for the ASF itself”，与项目内提交身份不重合。

title: 权限失效的判定时点
issue: 新章程“the determination of who is or is not an Active Contributor is made relative to the start of the registration period.”

title: 仓库分界与权限范围
issue: 管理页分设 srcmgr（前身称 base system 事权）、doceng、portmgr 三团队，各领 src、doc、ports 一树。

title: 项目边界在代码树中的体现
issue: 指南“the areas associated with a bit reflect who authorized the allocation of the commit bit”，树域与授权主体双标定。

title: 外部贡献的接入通道
issue: 指南“All pull requests committed to the FreeBSD repository should be reviewed by at least one person.”

title: 分支权限与主干权限的区分
issue: 指南以“committing non-obvious changes to a repo where you do not hold a commit bit”为须填 Approved by 之情形，琐碎修补则 Reviewed by 已足。

title: 边界之外的支持渠道
issue: 指南“A few people who have access to the FreeBSD machines do not have commit bits.”

title: 权限制度的分期与转折
issue: 章程页并列现行本与新本：前者 2000-08-28 经活跃提交者表决，后者 2026-05-27 通过而未生效；成文化与选举周期缩短两次调整可指认。

title: 章程修订的两代文本
issue: 章程页“approved by a vote of active committers on May 27, 2026. They have not yet entered into force.”

title: 选举周期由两年到一年的调整
issue: 旧本“Core elections are held every 2 years”，新本“Core Team Elections are held annually”。

title: 核心团队规模的调整
issue: 旧本“Core consists of 9 elected active committers”，新本“up to seven Voting Members and two Alternate Members”。

title: 任期限制的新设条款
issue: 新本“an Incumbent Core Team Member currently in their third or fourth consecutive year may not run for reelection”，任期上限由此确立。

title: 生效时点的过渡条款
issue: 新本“These revised bylaws will take effect in 2028, unless the Core Team elected in 2026 decides by two-thirds majority vote ... that they will take effect immediately”。

title: 贡献记录作为权限的前提
issue: 章程以“committed to the main branch ... in the last twelve months”为活跃贡献者要件，记录先于资格。

title: 所在机构对参与时间的支撑
issue: Producing OSS“If you hire good programmers, and they stick around long enough to get experience with the software and credibility in the community”，雇主付薪即购得参与时间。

title: 时间余裕与提交频率的联动
issue: 章程“Active committers have made a commit to the tree in the last 12 months.”，提交频率即活跃判据，时间余裕由此转为制度资格。

title: 权限构成的三个变量
issue: 三项变量系本节自设的分析框架，与节题“提交权限的构成：贡献记录、所在机构与时间余裕”同构，题面不作外部事实断言；各变量本身另有章程与 Producing OSS 支撑，此处判为编纂判准而非可证命题。

title: 非全职者的权限维持方式
issue: 手册称核心组成员多为志愿者，且 commitment 一词不得误读为 guaranteed support；章程复以十二月一次提交的低门槛维持活跃身份，零星投入足以续位而项目不承诺稳定支持。

title: 行为准则的文本来源
issue: 准则页“based on the LLVM Project's draft CoC, which in turn is based on the Django Project Code of Conduct, which in turn is based on wording from the Speak Up! project”。

title: 准则覆盖的空间范围
issue: 准则页“This code of conduct applies to all spaces managed by the FreeBSD project”，明列 online chat、mailing lists、bug trackers 与开发者会议。

title: 违规举报的收件通道
issue: 准则页“we ask that you report it by emailing conduct@FreeBSD.org”，并指向 Code of Conduct Committee。

title: 多元构成的宣示语句
issue: 准则页“We strive to be a community that welcomes and supports people of all backgrounds and identities”，其后开放列举出身与身份类别。

title: 准则公布的年份标记
issue: 准则页“Publication date: 2020-06-09”，另有 2023-06-22 修订记录，版本可定位。

title: 邀请制的早期做法
issue: 章程成文化迟至 2000-08-28，此前无成文程序可循；Producing OSS 述治理形式时称“new developers are invited in (and sometimes out)”，邀请制之早期形态可立。

title: 提交权限授予的程序化
issue: 管理页“Requests for new accounts will not be acted upon without the proper approval from the appropriate entity”；指南则以导师提名至 srcmgr、doceng 或 portmgr，提名、核准、开户三步齐备。

title: GSoC 管道与导师配对
issue: GSoC 页“The work is done under the guidance of one or more mentors and the effort is rewarded with a stipend.”

title: 实习生转为开发者的通道
issue: GSoC 页“Many of our past GSoC students have gone on to become FreeBSD developers.”

title: 三时段的制度差异
issue: 三时段比较系本节自设的叙事分层与编纂判准，题面不作外部事实断言；三段各别事实已在 15.1 至 15.4 逐条取证，制度密度递增属本卷判断。

title: 企业需求与共享维护的算路
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 5 章：“a company needs a particular piece of software to be maintained and developed, and does not need monopoly control of that software”；并称垄断会使“the entire burden of maintenance would fall on that one company, instead of being shared with others”，支撑共担优于独占。

title: 商业支持服务的市场空间
issue: Klara 官网：“Klara is at the intersection of enterprise and open source-applying our expert development and support services”；页面分设“Development services”与“Support subscriptions”，支撑商业公司以开发与支持合约切入并形成独立市场。属厂商自述。

title: 硬件厂商的生态角色
issue: iXsystems 史页：2001 年“The remainder of BSDi renames itself iXsystems and focuses solely on manufacturing servers and storage devices”；2018 年 TrueNAS M-Series 为“enterprise storage appliances based on Open Source”；2011 年共同资助 FreeBSD 图形驱动项目以“run on a wider range of hardware”，支撑存储厂商借开源扩大适用面。

title: 企业参与的技术议程诉求
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“The work can only be accepted based on its own merits and on how it fits into the community's vision for the software”，支撑出资方诉求仍须经共同体审议。

title: 层级组织与非强制共同体的接合
issue: 同章：“The key question is how the hierarchical command structures of corporations and the polyarchical, non-coercive communities of free software projects can work productively with each other”，与题旨逐字对应。

title: 商业支持公司的开发者编制
issue: Klara：“Our expert FreeBSD developers use a deliverable-based workflow to build custom boot loaders, device drivers, security features, and other kernel enhancements”，支撑专职工程师承接内核与驱动开发。属厂商自述。

title: 硬件公司的开发投入
issue: iXsystems 史页：2009 年接手 FreeNAS 并“reimplemented it for FreeBSD 8”；2011 年“co-sponsors FreeBSD Foundation project”；2010 年捐赠服务器用于 FreeBSD QAT，支撑整机厂商以营收投入系统开发与集成。

title: 雇佣关系在项目中的传导
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“If they are respected in the project, they will have influence beyond just their votes.”；“the weight given to your company's goals will be determined by its representatives' status in the project, rather than by your company's size, budget, or business plan”，支撑声誉与提交而非雇主规模。

title: 商业支持的业务范围
issue: Klara：“We provide comprehensive support services for FreeBSD and ZFS infrastructures”；同页开发栏列引导装载器、驱动与内核增强，支撑合约覆盖内核、驱动与基础设施。属厂商自述。

title: 自筹企业的资金模式
issue: iXsystems 关于页：“Founded in Silicon Valley in 2002, iXsystems, a profitable self-funded company”；自筹且盈利，无外部投资表述，支撑投入由营收支撑。

title: 捐助来源的双重构成
issue: FreeBSD Foundation：“Funded by individual and corporate donations, we invest directly in FreeBSD”，个人与企业两类捐助并列入账。

title: 个人小额捐助的累积
issue: DragonFly 捐助页按年列 2012—2026 捐助者名单，并称“you can make non-tax-deductible donations through PayPal”；名单按年登记成立，页面未公布金额，“小额”系依募捐形态的概括。

title: 捐助名单的非广告原则
issue: 同页：“We list donors here but we don't link back; this is not for advertising.”，列名不回链、不作推广，与题旨逐字对应。

title: 捐助用途的指定方式
issue: OpenBSD Foundation：“The Foundation uses all funds it receives to fund infrastructure costs for the projects, and developer events and initiatives”；并指向 Activities Page 逐项公开，支撑用途事先公开。

title: 两类出资方的并置募集
issue: 同页：“The Foundation needs contributions from Individuals and Companies to support its efforts.”，个人与企业两类出资并置。

title: 资金的分配优先级
issue: FreeBSD Foundation：“Most of our funding—over 60%—supports software development”；“Essential operations such as administration and fundraising make up a smaller share”，六成以上与其余分配成立。

title: 资金投放的优先次序
issue: 同页：“we prioritize directing resources where they have the greatest impact”，并依次列开发、宣传教育、基础设施与运营，支撑投放次序。

title: 法人账户与项目账户的分置
issue: DragonFly：“DragonFly is not yet incorporated as a non-profit”；“Matthew Dillon manages the account separately, and all money goes to DragonFly hardware or code bounties.”，支撑未设法人、个人代管与另账。

title: 年度财务报告的发布
issue: NetBSD Foundation 页：“The following status reports of the NetBSD Foundation are available:”，其下列 2004—2025 年度 Financial report，支撑逐年发布与可比序列。

title: 行政与筹款开支的占比
issue: FreeBSD Foundation：“Essential operations such as administration and fundraising make up a smaller share, providing the stability needed to sustain our work.”，占比低于开发与宣传，与题旨对应。

title: 薪酬劳动与志愿劳动的配比
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“most free software is written by paid developers, not by volunteers”；同段称早期“the proportion of truly unpaid volunteers was probably higher than it is now”，支撑两类并存且比例随年代变化。

title: 资源结构的非正式补贴
issue: 同章：“its office space and network bandwidth are donated, albeit unknowingly, by the organizations those people work for”，支撑雇主以场地与带宽补贴且多不成文。

title: 非正式协作的成型过程
issue: 同章以系统管理员互提修补为例：“what's happened is that an unofficial consortium has been formed”，与题旨一致。

title: 志愿劳动的组织化程度
issue: 同章：“Today such efforts are often more formalized. Corporations have become conscious of the benefits of open source software, and now involve themselves intentionally in its development.”，支撑形式化与企业介入。

title: 资金对人员流失的缓冲
issue: 同章：“the project will be less vulnerable to the Forces of Chaos (e.g., a key developer suddenly losing interest)”，支撑稳定资助降低关键开发者离去的中断风险。

title: 集群与主站的维护分工
issue: FreeBSD 管理页：“The Cluster Administrators are responsible for maintaining the machines and services that the project relies on for its distributed work and communication.”，与题旨逐字对应。

title: 硬件采购的资助来源
issue: OpenBSD Foundation 活动页：“The foundation funded the purchasing of machines for developers and project infrastructure.”，开发机与基础设施硬件由基金会出资。

title: 网络接入的会员资格支出
issue: 同页：“The foundation funded continued membership in Cybera, which enables OpenBSD to connect directly to Internet 2 for better educational institution connectivity.”，会员费对应教育网络接入。

title: 机房电力与冷却的成本项
issue: 同页：“The foundation funded the electrical and cooling costs for the primary site.”，逐字对应。

title: 硬件捐助的交付责任划分
issue: DragonFly：“You and the donating/receiving party must independently resolve any delivery issues. The DragonFly BSD Project is not responsible for any transactions.”，交付责任归双方。

title: 黑客松的资助名目
issue: OpenBSD Foundation：“The foundation funded developer expenses for: j2k25: japan hackathon, May 18 - 25, 2025, Nara, Japan”，按活动逐项列支开发者费用。

title: 会议差旅的报销规则
issue: 活动页仅逐项列“developer expenses for: [活动名、日期、地点]”，未载机票、住宿范围或人数核定办法；OpenBSD Foundation 与 OpenBSD 官网均未见报销细则，阻断在细则文本，故“覆盖机票与住宿、按人数核定”无从确证。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：报销细则无，题面收至范围并作缺口〕

title: 厂商峰会的组织方
issue: Foundation 活动页列“November 2026 FreeBSD Vendor Summit”；专页载“FreeBSD Vendor Summit Organizing Committee”、两日议程与会场 NetApp San Jose Campus，支撑基金会主办并定议程。

title: 活动资助的年度结算
issue: OpenBSD Foundation 按年分节：“During 2024 the foundation supported the following activities.”，逐年列活动，支撑按筹款年度结算与逐项公开。

title: 开发者聚会的专属性质
issue: OpenBSD 目标页：“Focus on being developer-oriented in all senses, including holding developer-only events called hackathons.”，限定开发者参加，逐字对应。

title: 法人实体与项目决策的分置
issue: Foundation：“We also serve as the Project's recognized legal entity, managing contracts, licenses, and other agreements on its behalf”；FreeBSD 管理页称 Core Team “responsible for deciding the project's overall goals and direction”，支撑法人代管与决策归项目。

title: 资金换取的信用而非控制
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“So money needs to be used carefully, and without communicating an intent to control.”；“it buys development credibility, which is convertible to influence”，支撑信用折算而非直接控制。

title: 中立托管平台的职能
issue: Linux Foundation：“a 501(c)(6) non-profit, has provided a neutral home and unmatched support for cutting-edge projects”；页面列“business operations, training & certification, marketing and events, and membership development”，支撑共同法律与运营外壳。

title: 出资方在共同体中的权重
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“the weight given to your company's goals will be determined by its representatives' status in the project, rather than by your company's size, budget, or business plan.”，逐字对应。

title: 独立性在人事上的落点
issue: FreeBSD 管理页：“The Core Team is elected by the active developers in the project.”；同页称 Core Team 决定整体目标与方向，支撑人事与提交权不由出资方指派。

title: 未注册非营利的税务限制
issue: DragonFly：“DragonFly is not yet incorporated as a non-profit, meaning no tax benefit is available for donating time or goods to the project.”，逐字对应。

title: 单一账户的代管安排
issue: 同页：“Matthew Dillon manages the account separately, and all money goes to DragonFly hardware or code bounties.”，支撑资金集中于个人代管账户。

title: 自筹公司的资金模式
issue: iXsystems 关于页仅称“a profitable self-funded company”，未披露储备规模、外部融资或市场波动下的投入调整；题内“缺少外部缓冲，随市场波动”无一手依据，且标题与 V65.2.2.5 近重复。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：自筹缓冲说无一手，题面收至资金边界〕

title: 小型项目的人手集中度
issue: DragonFly 团队页：“The DragonFly Project, like many open source projects, is a technical project supported by a team of geographically separated people.”；同页称 Matt Dillon“is also the principal code contributor”，支撑少数地域分散者支撑项目。

title: 募资量级与资源上限
issue: OpenBSD Foundation：“The Foundation received $380,653 in new donations during its 2024 fund raising campaign.”；同页 2022 年 $398,928、2021 年 $580,958，均为数十万美元量级。

title: 资助方与议程的对应
issue: OpenBSD Foundation：“The foundation funds a number of activities for OpenBSD to ensure that we have infrastructure to support development, and that developers can meet and move the OS forward.”；活动清单并列开发支持、机器采购与黑客松。

title: 议程设定中的开发者意愿
issue: OpenBSD FAQ：“The answer is based on two things: the wishes of the developers and compatibility with the goals of the project.”，支撑取舍依开发者意愿。

title: KAME 项目的资助来源
issue: KAME 官网：“The KAME Project is a joint effort… Talented researchers from several Japanese organizations joined the project”；“KAME's code is based on WIDE Hydrangea IPv6/IPsec stack”；WIDE 年表载 1998 年“Launch of the KAME project”（2006 年 3 月结束）；官网称代码“has been merged to FreeBSD and NetBSD”。机构联合投入与学术项目基础成立，未见单列现金资助账目。

title: 企业介入开发的自觉化
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“Corporations have become conscious of the benefits of open source software, and now involve themselves intentionally in its development.”，逐字对应。

title: 资源投向的年度取舍
issue: OpenBSD Foundation 年度清单并列“funding for developer support”“purchasing of machines”“developer expenses for”黑客松，支撑有限资金在三类投向间分配。

title: 长期预算的年度连续性
issue: 活动页按 2014—2025 逐年分节：“During 2025 the foundation supported the following activities.”，构成可比收支序列。

title: 捐赠总额与支出规模的对照
issue: 同页：“The Foundation received $398,928 in new donations during its 2022 Fund raising Campaign. During 2022 the foundation paid out $351,842 to support its activities.”，捐款与支出并置公布。

title: 持续性依赖的人员条件
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“Survivability is the project's ability to continue independently of any individual participant or sponsor — think of it as the likelihood that the project would continue even if all of its founding members were to move on to other things.”，逐字对应。

title: 筹款节奏与项目年度
issue: 活动页与 campaign2024 页仅列年度募款目标、实收与支出；2024 目标 $350,000 而实收 $380,653，2022 实收低于 2021 而支出反升（$351,842 对 $267,000），未见“未达目标即压缩次年支出”的规则表述，阻断在预算规则文本。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：压缩规则无一手，改落实收与支出的错位〕

title: 资金的多元投向分布
issue: FreeBSD Foundation：“Most of our funding—over 60%—supports software development”；“We also dedicate a significant portion to advocacy and education”，并另列基础设施与运营，支撑投向多元。

title: 受薪维护的普遍程度
issue: 引《Producing Open Source》第 5 章“The Economics of Open Source”：“most free software is written by paid developers, not by volunteers.” 该句为自由软件总体概括而非 BSD 专项统计，但直接支撑“受薪维护普遍”。

title: 维护工作的薪酬出处
issue: Klara Systems 官网分设“FreeBSD and OS Development”与“ZFS and FreeBSD Support”两栏：“We provide comprehensive support services for FreeBSD and ZFS infrastructures”“Our support subscription ensures you have capable experts you can count on”；支持以订阅计价，支撑“薪酬出处”。属厂商自述。

title: 无偿维护者的时间成本
issue: OpenBSD FAQ 第 1 节：“The maintainers of OpenBSD support the project largely from their own pockets.” 同段并列编程时间、设备、网络资源与答复缺陷报告所耗时间，支撑时间与金钱同属投入。

title: 基金会资助的岗位设置
issue: FreeBSD Handbook 1.3.3：“The Foundation funds software development via project grants and provides staff to immediately respond to urgent problems and implement new features and functionality.” 句意逐字对应题旨。

title: 个人薪酬与项目收益的分离
issue: 同页 1.3.3：“most members of the core team are also volunteers”；并称开发者对报酬“we are definitely not prepared to insist on it”，支撑核心团队无偿与项目财务不构成个人收益。

title: 专职维护的交付标准
issue: Klara 官网：“Our expert FreeBSD developers use a deliverable-based workflow”，其后列举引导装载器、驱动与内核增强；按交付物计工支撑“可验收任务”。属厂商自述。

title: 无偿参与的位置与限度
issue: 仅见《Producing Open Source》：“the proportion of truly unpaid volunteers was probably higher”，作者脚注自述此系 educated guess、无严谨研究；Riehle 等实证称“about 50% of all open source software development has been paid work for many years now”，方向上不支持“比例已低于早期”。缺独立统计，阻断在量化证据。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：两源方向相反，题面改估计分歧〕

title: 任职参与的合同形态
issue: Klara 官网：“Support Subscriptions offer businesses ongoing access”；“Our support subscription ensures you have capable experts you can count on”，订阅制即按期续订的服务合约，支撑合同形态。属厂商自述。

title: 赞助参与的间接链条
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“it buys development credibility, which is convertible to influence”；同段强调金钱不直接购买影响力，支撑经开发信用折算的间接链条。

title: 三种位置的决策权差异
issue: 同章：“They will have a vote, or if there are many of them, they will have a voting block.”；“can influence the project by the same means as any other member”，并以代表在项目中的地位而非公司规模定权重，支撑票数与声望差序。

title: 位置转换的常见路径
issue: FreeBSD GSoC 页：“The work is done under the guidance of one or more mentors”；“Many of our past GSoC students have gone on to become FreeBSD developers.” 支撑导师制与外部参与者转入提交者通道。

title: 无偿者的退出机制
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“They may never complain overtly on the mailing lists.” 并以“less and less noise from sources outside the main funded group”描述退出，支撑静默减少投入而非公开申诉。

title: 动机表述中的兴趣成分
issue: OpenBSD FAQ：“Programmers who enjoy writing operating systems are naturally always welcome”；FreeBSD Handbook：“We are constantly on the lookout for new volunteers”，兴趣语汇进入招募语句。

title: 倦怠与外流的结构原因
issue: 《Producing Open Source》：“this can divide a project into in-group and out-group developers”；未受薪者“leave for a project that seems more like a meritocracy”，支撑资金集中致内外群体之分与退出。

title: 留存与可见度的关系
issue: 同章：“there will be fewer and fewer large code contributions from unexpected sources”，并及设计讨论中意外意见减少，逐字对应题旨。

title: 静默退出的行为特征
issue: 同章：“They may never complain overtly on the mailing lists.”；同段述外围噪声递减，支撑只逐步减少投入而不公开抱怨。

title: 社区健康的衡量指标
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 4 章：“Operational health”定义为“ongoing ability to incorporate new code contributions and new developers, and to be responsive to incoming bug reports”，逐字对应题旨。

title: 巴士系数与交接风险
issue: 同章脚注：“Bus Factor”即“how many participants would have to get hit by a bus”，并释为项目无法延续的临界人数，支撑交接风险的量化口径。

title: 技术分歧与社交分歧的分野
issue: 引 FreeBSD 社区行为准则：“Disagreements, both social and technical, happen all the time and FreeBSD is no exception.”；同段“It is important that we resolve disagreements and differing views constructively.”；《Producing Open Source》第 8 章亦分“technical disagreements and interpersonal conflicts”。两类分歧并存获一手与独立二手支撑。

title: 决策与冲突的解释难度
issue: 引《Producing Open Source》第 4 章：“Meritocracy, cooperation, and running code are all part of it, but they do little to explain how projects actually make decisions on a day-to-day basis, and say nothing about how conflicts are resolved.”；同段并称“the question is not easy to answer.”，支撑“难以用单一原则说明”。

title: 争议解决的非正式手段
issue: 同章：“Others use a less formal structure, but more personal self-restraint on the part of leaders, to produce an atmosphere of fairness that people can rely on as a de facto form of governance.” 逐字支撑“非正式手段＋领袖自我克制构成事实上的治理”。

title: 冲突记录的制度化载体
issue: 章程“Core Interpretations of the Bylaws”节：“Core will issue interpretations of the bylaws from time to time as necessary to clarify areas that might be ambiguous in the bylaws as enacted...”；页面现存解释条目 20020503（提前选举重置下次选举日期），解释以日期条目存档，可援引。

title: 分叉事件在编年中的次序
issue: 题指本卷第 2 节内分叉事件的编年位次，属叙事分层与编目判准，不含外部事实断言；目录核查第 4 章第 2 节题“NetBSD 内部冲突与 OpenBSD 分叉”，本节为其下位论题，位次与“分叉事件编年正身＝第二十七卷第3章”的分工注相合。

title: 硬分叉与开发分叉的区别
issue: 引《Producing Open Source》第 8 章：“There are two types of forks: development forks and hard forks.” 与“Hard forks (also sometimes called social forks) are much less common, and are much more significant when they happen.” 逐字支撑少见而有影响、与开发分叉不可混同。

title: 分叉后的正统认定问题
issue: 同章：“Once a project forks, there is no definitive answer to the question of which fork is the ‘true’ or ‘original’ project.”；并称“It is not the case that there is an objective truth from the outset”，而“when a large enough percentage of observers agree that one side or the other is the project or is the fork, that belief starts to become true.”，正统取决于观察者共识。

title: 分叉作为信心投票
issue: 同章：“a fork is, in essence, a vote of confidence.” 逐字支撑“分叉实质上是一次投票”。

title: 5.0 发布前的开发周期
issue: 5.0-RELEASE 公告（2003-01-19）：“The culmination of nearly three years of work, this release starts FreeBSD on the path of advanced multiprocessor and application thread support...”，支撑“近三年工作的收束”。

title: 新技术栈的引入清单
issue: 同公告“Among the long list of new and improved features:”下列“UFS2, the second generation UFS filesystem”“Fine-grained locking in the kernel”“GEOM, the extensible and flexible storage framework, and DEVFS”，题列三项均在清单内。

title: 保守用户的迁移提示
issue: 同公告：“More conservative users may prefer to continue using FreeBSD 4.X.” 逐字支撑保守用户迁移提示与采用分层。

title: 发布说明中的风险提示
issue: 同公告：“Although FreeBSD 5.0 contains a number of new and exciting features, it may not be suitable for all users.” 风险于发布公告即前置披露。

title: 分叉起点与版本依据
issue: DragonFly 官方历史页：“DragonFly BSD was forked from FreeBSD 4.8 in June of 2003, by Matthew Dillon.” 版本基线与时间同句给出，以版本号标定起点与本页叙述口径一致。

title: 分叉公告的自我定位
issue: 同页：“The project was originally billed as ‘the logical continuation of the FreeBSD 4.x series’, as quoted in the announcement”，并称“this description has long since become obsolete.”，自我定位由官方页自述。

title: 首个技术目标的设定
issue: 同页：“The ultimate goal of the DragonFly project at its inception was to provide native clustering support in the kernel.” 逐字支撑首个技术目标。

title: 分叉后与上游的组件共用
issue: 同页：“the adoption of the pkgsrc framework for management of all non-base-system third-party applications in order to pool our resources with other BSD projects using this framework.” 支撑共用资源；惟 pkgsrc 出自 NetBSD，题中“上游”宜读作 BSD 同族上游而非 FreeBSD 本体。

title: 项目领袖的技术主张
issue: DragonFly 团队页“Project Leader”栏：“Matt is the founder of The DragonFly Project.”，领袖身份与创建者身份合一。

title: 技术路线的个人印记
issue: 同页：“Matt is also the principal code contributor to DragonFly BSD and supports the website and other online resources for this project.” 支撑主要代码贡献集中于一人。

title: 路线之争的裁决归属
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 4 章：“even projects that are not formally organized as democracies are, in practice, democracies when it comes to important decisions.”；并称“things rarely get that far, because the dictator compromises first.”，支撑裁决归属与先行妥协。

title: 追随与选择的双重性
issue: 同章：“It may well be that everyone is willing to defer to one leader, but this is because they choose to do so, in a situation where they really do have freedom of choice.” 逐字支撑服从出于自愿、退出权在手。

title: 纪律条款的成文化程度
issue: 提交者手册：“As noted, breaking some of these rules can be grounds for suspension or, upon repeated offense, permanent removal of commit privileges.”，违规与处置成文于手册。

title: 违规处置的量刑阶梯
issue: 同节：个人可“temporarily suspend commit privileges”，逾一周停权或永久移除须“a 2/3 majority of core”同意，并称重犯可“permanent removal of commit privileges”，阶梯成文。

title: 处置与移除的次序
issue: 同节：“Violators will be removed from the FreeBSD developers mailing list, resulting in a suspension of commit privileges.” 逐字，移出列表即附带停权。

title: 停权期限的议定方式
issue: 同节：“a committer whose privileges are suspended or revoked is entitled to a ‘hearing’ by core, the total duration of the suspension being determined at that time.”，停权时长于听证时议定。

title: 法人角色与项目角色的分工
issue: NetBSD 基金会页：“The NetBSD Foundation serves as the legal entity which owns several of the NetBSD Project servers, handles donations of money, services, hardware or time to the project, and administers NetBSD copyrights.”，法人角色与项目角色分工成立。

title: 基金会与核心团队的联络机制
issue: FreeBSD 2012 年第三季度状态报告：“David Chisnall replaced Robert Watson as liaison to the FreeBSD Foundation.”，核心团队设基金会联络人；administration 页亦列“(Core Team Liaison)”席位。

title: 个人领导在法人结构中的地位
issue: DragonFly 团队页列 Matt 为“Project Leader”“founder”“principal code contributor”，无任何法人职位；捐赠页称“DragonFly is not yet incorporated as a non-profit”，且“Matthew Dillon manages the account separately”，权威系于代码贡献而非法人席位。

title: 三方关系的章程依据
issue: 章程：“A Core Team Member’s tenure lasts until ... c) their removal by a two-thirds majority vote of Voting Members, whichever comes first.”；现行（2000 年）章程另有“Core members and committers may be ejected by a 2/3 vote of core”，席位与罢免均回章程核对。

title: 硬分叉的社会成因
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 8 章：“Some forks are due to amicable but irreconcilable disagreements about the direction of the project; perhaps more are due to both technical disagreements and interpersonal conflicts.” 方向分歧与人际因素并陈。

title: 分叉作为表决机制
issue: 同章：“If more than half of the developers are in favor of whatever course the fork proposes to take, usually there is no need to fork”；“if fewer than half of the developers are in favor, the fork is a clearly minority rebellion.”，分叉因而是少数派退出。

title: 分叉威胁的治理效应
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 4 章：“the more serious the threat of a fork becomes, the more willing people are to compromise to avoid it.” 逐字支撑威胁的治理效应。

title: 制度解释的适用边界
issue: 第 8 章：“There are two types of forks: development forks and hard forks. The distinction between them is important.” 逐字支撑区分是制度分析前提。

title: 不可复制资产的归属争议
issue: 同章：“there can be a question of what happens to non-copyable assets: not just trademarks, but perhaps money in the bank, hardware, that full-color conference banner sitting in a storage locker somewhere, etc.”，商标、资金与硬件齐列。

title: 人员分流与协作可能
issue: 同章：“don’t force people to make exclusive choices”；并称“after a fork some developers often openly work on both projects, doing their best to keep the two compatible.”，支撑不逼二选一与跨项目协作。

title: 名称与品牌的分置
issue: 同章：“Everyone, both developers and users, will treat the fork as a new project, with a new name ..., a separate web site, and a separate philosophy or goal.”；商标权持有组织决定何者“正统”，品牌随组织而非代码。

title: 上游对分叉的协助姿态
issue: 同章：“don’t force people to make exclusive choices, and be as cooperative as is practicable with the fork.”；同段以“the loss of developers and users”为项目真正损失。

title: 章程修订的触发条件
issue: 章程：“Changes to these bylaws may be proposed at any time by the Core Team or by a petition signed by 5% of Active Contributors.”；惟此条属 2026-05-27 通过的新章程，页注“They have not yet entered into force.”，2028 年生效。

title: 表决门槛的制度设计
issue: 同章程：“Any amendment that receives two thirds or more of the votes cast in the poll is deemed to have passed and takes effect simultaneously with the investiture of the newly elected Core Team.”，门槛为所投票数三分之二；同属未生效新章程。

title: 规则变更的参与率约束
issue: 现行（2000 年）章程：“These rules can be changed by a 2/3 majority of committers if at least 50% of active committers cast their vote.”，参与率下限成文；新章程未保留同额下限，仅要求与选举投票同期举行。

title: 行为准则作为软性调整
issue: 题旨“不设强制罚则”与一手相悖：准则正文固为劝诫（“take it in the spirit in which it’s intended - a guide”），但其报告页明列处置手段：“A private reprimand from the working group”“A public reprimand”“An imposed vacation from FreeBSD Project controlled spaces”“A permanent or temporary ban from some or all FreeBSD Project controlled spaces”，并由 Core Team 管辖的准则委员会执行；故宜表述为劝诫文本与执行机制并存。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-02〕
suggested_title: 行为准则的劝诫与执行

title: 伯克利遗产的制度继承
issue: NetBSD 关于页：“The NetBSD code was originally derived from 4.4BSD Lite2 from the University of California, Berkeley.”；同页法人说明另称基金会“owns the trademark of the word ‘NetBSD’”，代码与许可承自伯克利体系。

title: 断裂处的制度重建
issue: DragonFly 历史页：“One of the important works included the simplification and general cleanup of the majority of the kernel subsystems.”；并称项目第一阶段“focused on rewriting most of the major kernel subsystems”，支撑技术重建；组织重建面该页未直载，属编纂推断。

title: 继承与断裂的并存形态
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 8 章：“This new copy of the project represents a potentially permanent divergence”，与历史页谱系叙述（自由 FreeBSD 4.8 分叉）并行，继承与分离同存。

title: 分叉后的共同体再造
issue: DragonFly 团队页：“Many individuals have stepped up to contribute various pieces of code, documentation, ideas, and feedback to The DragonFly Project.”，共同体由分散个人补位重组。

title: 教堂与市集的两种组织
issue: 《大教堂与市集》摘要：“the ‘cathedral’ model of most of the commercial world versus the ‘bazaar’ model of the Linux world.”，集中规划与分散试错两形态对照。

title: 制度弹性来自退出权
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 4 章：“The potential for forks is the reason there are no true dictators in free software projects.” 逐字支撑可分叉性消解真正独裁。

title: 治理结构的常见类型
issue: Open Source Guides：“There are three common governance structures associated with open source projects.”，下列 BDFL、Meritocracy 与 liberal contribution policy 三类，与题三类对应。

title: 制度弹性的上限所在
issue: 同章：“just because forkability puts an upper limit on how much power anyone can exert in a project doesn’t mean there aren’t important differences in how projects are governed.”，上限与治理差异并存。

title: 法人与项目的托管关系
issue: netbsd.org/foundation 页：“serves as the legal entity which owns several of the NetBSD Project servers, handles donations of money, services, hardware or time to the project, and administers NetBSD copyrights.” 持有服务器、接收捐助、管理版权三事逐字对应题旨。

title: 资金与法律资产的集中管理
issue: GNOME Foundation 首页：“It provides essential functions and support for GNOME” 同句续列 “funds and legal assets”，资金与法律资产由法人管理；“项目本身不直接持有”系由该托管关系推出的口径，页内无对应否定语式。

title: 商标与许可的持有主体
issue: GNOME 首页：“The GNOME Foundation is the owner of the GNOME trademarks.”；NetBSD 章程序言另称基金会 “own the trademark of the word” 后接 NetBSD（原文该词以直引号括注）。两法人商标归属见页，名号使用权随法人而定。

title: 基金会的中立性功能
issue: Linux 基金会 About 页：“has provided a neutral home and unmatched support for cutting-edge projects”。中立外壳与多项目托管为机构自述；“降低单一厂商的控制疑虑”属由中立性推出的功能判断，页内无对应表述。

title: 501(c)(3) 法人的定位
issue: FreeBSD Foundation About 页：“The FreeBSD Foundation is a US-based 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to supporting the FreeBSD Project and community.” 法人类别、属地与宗旨逐字对应题旨。

title: 认可法人的合同与许可职能
issue: 同页：“recognized legal entity, managing contracts, licenses, and other agreements on its behalf”。项目认可为法人，代签合同与许可协议，词序与题旨同构。

title: 资金投向的优先级
issue: 同页：“we invest directly in FreeBSD through software development, infrastructure improvements, advocacy, training, and community engagement.” 开发、基础设施、宣传、培训四项在列，与题内四类分项一致。

title: 运营开支的占比结构
issue: 同页：“Essential operations such as administration and fundraising make up a smaller share, providing the stability needed to sustain our work.”；另称 “over 60%” 投向软件开发。占比为定性描述，未见逐项百分比表，“被压低”系据此定性语。

title: 与项目团队的联络安排
issue: 已查 freebsd.org/administration、freebsd.org/internal、freebsdfoundation.org 的 About 与 Board of Directors 页：Security Team 名录所载 “Core Team Liaison” 属安全组对 Core 的联络，非基金会与项目间的席位；现行 Core Team 名录已无联络标注，基金会官网亦未载联络席位。阻断点：无一手页明示该联络安排，暂不作定案。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：联络席位无一手，题面收至归属辨认〕

title: 特拉华州法人的章程依据
issue: netbsd.org/foundation：“The NetBSD Foundation is incorporated in the State of Delaware, and is governed by a set of bylaws.” 属地与章程治理逐字对应。

title: 董事会由开发者选举产生
issue: 同页：“The Board members were elected by the NetBSD Developer community”；同页逐人列 “Term expires” 与 “Last elected”，任期与选举年可逐人核对。

title: 执行委员会的设置与分工
issue: 执行委员会页：“Per Section 5.9 of the bylaws of The NetBSD Foundation, the following executive committees were formed on January 14, 2003, and amended on March 11, 2003” 下辖 finance 与 membership；core 另于 2003/09/23 设立。章程授权、财务与会员两委会及核心组均见页。

title: 会员资格与表决程序
issue: 章程：“Membership in the Foundation shall be open to all NetBSD developers who have signed the NetBSD Project Development Agreement”；“These amendments shall be put forth to the Active Members for a vote”；并规定由董事会 “promulgate the list of Active Members”。名册与表决程序入章程。

title: 财务与会员事务的委员会
issue: 执行委员会页：finance-exec 宗旨 “To oversee and maintain a record of the financial business of the Foundation.”；membership-exec 宗旨 “To oversee all aspects of membership in the Foundation.” 两委会各设，职责见于设立与修订记录。

title: 加拿大非营利法人的构造
issue: 基金会首页：“The OpenBSD Foundation is a Canadian not-for-profit corporation”；捐赠页：“We are a Canadian federally incorporated not-for-profit corporation”。法域为加拿大联邦注册；“而非美国 501(c)(3)” 系由法域推出的否定判断，页内未直书该语。

title: 资助范围与关联项目
issue: 首页列出 “OpenBSD and related projects such as OpenSSH, OpenBGPD, OpenNTPD, OpenSMTPD, LibreSSL, mandoc and rpki-client”；宗旨语称法人目标为 “support and further the development, advancement, and maintenance of free software”。范围与宗旨均见页。

title: 资金用途的公开口径
issue: 首页：“The Foundation uses all funds it receives to fund infrastructure costs for the projects, and developer events and initiatives”；并指向 “See our Activities Page for more details.” 用途范围与明细出处均在页。

title: 捐款收据与税务限制
issue: 捐赠页：“We are not a registered charity, in the sense that we do not issue tax deductible receipts.”；“We can issue receipts for donations which while not deductible as charitable donations in Canada may be used for accounting and/or tax purposes.” 同段称注册慈善的会计与法律成本 prohibitive，税务限制影响募资方式。

title: 筹款活动的年度节奏
issue: 活动页按 2014 至 2026 逐年分节，2024 年节载 received $380,653 in new donations，2022 年节载 paid out $351,842，并逐项列支出；年度节奏与支出明细可核。年度目标额另载于各年 campaign 页，活动页本身记实收与实支。

title: 未设法人实体的制度缺口
issue: DragonFly 捐赠页：“DragonFly is not yet incorporated as a non-profit” 与 “no tax benefit is available for donating time or goods to the project”。未注册非营利与无税务优惠两事见页；“募资吸引力受限”为由此外推的判断。

title: 个人代管账户的安排
issue: 同页：“Matthew Dillon manages the account separately, and all money goes to DragonFly hardware or code bounties.” 账户由 Dillon 分管、款项专用于硬件与悬赏；“创建者”身分页内未标，属常识性补充。

title: 硬件捐助的私人渠道
issue: 同页：“please contact the requestor directly”，并附抄送 donations 邮箱。捐赠方直连受赠者，项目仅抄送，不居中处理。

title: 无基金会状态的项目风险
issue: 同页：“You and the donating/receiving party must independently resolve any delivery issues.” 与 “The DragonFly BSD Project is not responsible for any transactions.” 交付争议与责任归属明示不由项目承担。

title: 501(c)(6) 的协会法人属性
issue: Linux 基金会 About 页：“a 501(c)(6) non-profit”。501(c)(6) 属商业联盟类；同页列 membership development 为服务项，与会员制结构相合。

title: 中立托管与项目聚合
issue: 同页：“has provided a neutral home and unmatched support for cutting-edge projects”。托管页并列三级托管形态（Community Project、Community Project + Funding、Umbrella Community + Funding），多项目聚合见页。

title: 会员企业的协作接口
issue: About 页：“We help companies and developers identify and contribute to the projects that matter.” 企业与开发者的对接语逐字见页；“以项目为单位”由同页项目导向表述支持。

title: 商业协作与治理权的分离
issue: About 页：“We provide turnkey technology and support programs for developer enablement, business operations, training & certification, marketing and events, and membership development”；托管页：“The LF won't take over and reset your technical direction and vision back to day zero.” 运营服务与项目技术自主分置。

title: 董事会与 PMC 的两级治理
issue: ASF 页：“Board of Directors (board) governs the foundation and is composed of members.”；“Project Management Committees (PMCs) govern the projects”。两级主体与所辖对象见文，权责分层明确。

title: 功劳制下的角色序列
issue: 同页：“The meritocracy typically has various roles within each individual Apache project community:” 后列 user、developer、committer、PMC member、PMC chair、ASF member 六级，各级以贡献与同侪选任取得。

title: PMC 的技术决定权
issue: 同页：“has technical decision-making authority regarding the content and direction of the project.” 内容与方向两项逐字对应题旨。

title: 主席任命与委员选举的界限
issue: 同页：“The Board appoints the Chair of a PMC from the PMC members.”；“A PMC member is a committer who was elected due to merit for the evolution of the project.”；“The PMC as a whole is the entity that controls the project, nobody else.” 主席由董事会任命，委员由项目内选举。

title: 共识表决的懒共识规则
issue: 同页：“projects make decisions with a lazy consensus approach: a few positive votes with no negative vote is enough to get going.” 少数赞成、无反对即可推进。

title: 会员制与选举董事会的组合
issue: GNOME Foundation 首页：“The GNOME Foundation is a membership-based organization with an elected board of directors.” 会员制与选举董事会逐字见页。

title: 顾问委员会的咨询职能
issue: GNOME 治理页：“The Advisory Board has no decision-making authority but provides a vehicle for its members to communicate with the Board of Directors”。no decision-making authority 支撑“只咨询、不介入决策”。

title: 商标持有与生态边界
issue: 首页：“The GNOME Foundation is the owner of the GNOME trademarks.” 商标归属见页；“生态边界随商标许可划定”为由此推出的功能判断，页内另指 legal page。

title: 桌面生态的资金用途
issue: 首页：“Donations are essential for us to improve our development infrastructure, host community events, and keep Flathub running.” 基础设施、社区活动与 Flathub 运营三项逐字对应。

title: 项目起源的两人起点
issue: gnome.org/about：“The GNOME project was founded in 1997 by two students, Miguel de Icaza and Federico Mena.” 年份、两人与学生身分逐字见页。

title: 代码可分叉性与自治基础
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 4 章定义 forkability 为“the ability of anyone to take a copy of the source code and use it to start a competing project, known as a fork”，并称其为“the indispensable ingredient that binds developers together”。可复制另立即自治的物质前提，题旨成立。

title: 公共资源的托管归属
issue: NetBSD 基金会页：“The NetBSD Foundation serves as the legal entity which owns several of the NetBSD Project servers, handles donations of money, services, hardware or time to the project, and administers NetBSD copyrights.”；章程前言另称基金会“own the trademark of the word ‘NetBSD’”；FreeBSD 基金会自称“the Project’s recognized legal entity”。资金、商标、基础设施均有法人承接。

title: 自治的正式与非正式两种
issue: 同章：“Some involve a formal governance structure… Others use a less formal structure, but more personal self-restraint on the part of leaders”；并断言“Both ways lead to the same result: a sense of institutional permanence”。正式章程与非正式自律同效，题旨原文可对。

title: 资本进入后的自治限度
issue: 第 5 章：“If not handled carefully, this can divide a project into in-group and out-group developers”；未受薪者“leave for a project that seems more like a meritocracy”。原文为条件句，题作“会削弱”宜读作风险而非必然。

title: 法人、项目与制品的三角
issue: FreeBSD 基金会：“We also serve as the Project’s recognized legal entity, managing contracts, licenses, and other agreements on its behalf.”；项目行政页称核心团队“responsible for deciding the project’s overall goals and direction”。法人持法律事务、项目持决策、制品为产出，三角可分。

title: 三分离判准的落点
issue: 所有权、决策权、产出归属三项判准属编纂分析框架，题内无年代、人数、机构等外部事实断言；与目录第 6 章第 2 节“判准与反例”分层一致，离线核对通过。

title: 主体错置的常见类型
issue: “主体错置”为分类学判断而非史实陈述，其前提（法人不等于项目）见基金会页与行政页；题属编纂判准类，离线核对与同节“判准”层级一致。

title: 商标归属作为判准之一
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 8 章：“If there is some organization with trademark rights to the name… that usually resolves the issue by fiat: that organization will decide who is the original project and who is the fork”。商标归属即判定何者为分叉。

title: 核心团队的董事会类比
issue: 手册 1.3：“The FreeBSD core team would be equivalent to the board of directors if the FreeBSD Project were a company.”，并称其职责为使项目“in good shape and is heading in the right directions”。紧接一句又自评“The ‘board of directors’ analogy above is not very accurate”，类比系作者自述而非严格定性。

title: 选举人资格的时间门槛
issue: 现行章程：“Active committers have made a commit to the tree in the last 12 months.”；新章程：“An Active Contributor is someone who has… committed to the main branch… in the last twelve months”，且“Any Active Contributor, and only Active Contributors, may vote”“may run”。两版均以十二月为门槛。

title: 年度选举的八周流程
issue: 新章程：“the election phases are intended to run consecutively with no gap or overlap, for a total of eight weeks terminating no later than the second Wednesday of May.”；细分为登记 2 周、投票 4 周、计票 1 周、公告后 1 周生效。“年度”见“Core Team Elections are held annually”，惟该章程 2026-05-27 通过而“尚未生效”，现行仍为两年一届、1＋4＋1 周。

title: 任期与交替成员的分层
issue: 新章程：“consists of up to seven Voting Members and two Alternate Members. Alternate Members participate in meetings and discussions but do not vote.”；票序前三名任两年、其后一年直至七名，再下两名任一年候补。分层与按票序分任期均见原文。

title: 职位轮换的任期上限
issue: Hats Term Limits Policy：“In general it is expected that volunteers serving in hat positions will be limited to serving for four consecutive years, rounded up to the first natural review/appointment cycle.”；另有“Core shall review all hats annually”。属软性预期而非硬性禁令。

title: 核心组的技术管理层级
issue: NetBSD 核心组页：“If the NetBSD Project were a large company, the NetBSD core group would be the technical management.”；同页称其“set the direction and goals of the NetBSD Project as a whole”。

title: 核心组的架构议题职责
issue: 同页：“consider the serious architectural questions that need to be addressed if the NetBSD Project is going to keep producing a viable system”，与“维持系统可用性”逐字对应。

title: 董事会与核心组的两层结构
issue: 基金会页：“The NetBSD Foundation has a Board of Directors”；核心组页定位为技术管理层。惟章程仅设董事会（Article V，Directors），全文无 core group 条款，故“由章程分置”宜读作两套文件各管一层。

title: 成员资格的取得与终止
issue: 章程 3.1：“A Member of the Foundation is a developer who has signed the NetBSD Project Development agreement”；“A Member may have his/her membership terminated if s/he is Inactive”，须先书面通知并留答复期；3.3：“such former Member may reapply for membership”。取得、终止、重申请三环齐备。

title: 核心组名单的更替记录
issue: 核心组页列“Previous NetBSD Core Group members:”，含 Theo de Raadt、Charles Hannum、Jason Thorpe、Luke Mewburn 等，人员更替留有公开名册。

title: 维护者自筹的经费结构
issue: OpenBSD FAQ：“The maintainers of OpenBSD support the project largely from their own pockets.”，并列编程时间、设备、网络资源与答复缺陷报告所耗时间。Goals 页另设“Project Funding”指向捐赠页，故“不依赖法人拨款”宜读作以自筹为主。

title: 技术署名中的领袖痕迹
issue: Innovations 页 Theo de Raadt 署名凡 32 处，含单独署名条目如“Theo de Raadt, April 12, 2018”“Theo de Raadt, June 2017”，另有“Theo de Raadt, August 25, 1996, OpenBSD 2.0”。同一人反复署名，技术主导集中可见。

title: 技术优先的决策口径
issue: Goals 页：“Be as politics-free as possible; solutions should be decided on the basis of technical merit.” 逐字对应“去政治化”“以技术优劣为准”。

title: 长期在位的制度代价
issue: 《Producing Open Source》第 4 章：“The nominal ‘dictator’ has no magical hold over the project… If the dictator were to suddenly start making bad decisions, there would be restlessness, followed eventually by revolt and a fork.” 可证个人主导的失当风险；惟“缺少轮替机制”“接续安排”系论者推断，OpenBSD 官方页未载继任条款。

title: 创始人身份与代码主导
issue: DragonFly 团队页：“Matt is the founder of The DragonFly Project. Matt is also the principal code contributor to DragonFly BSD…”；手册另称“final say on all code submissions goes to Matt Dillon, as originator of this project”。创始人与主要代码贡献者二重身份成立。

title: 网站与资源的个人维护
issue: 团队页：“Matt is also the principal code contributor to DragonFly BSD and supports the website and other online resources for this project.” 主语为 Matt，站点与在线资源系于个人。

title: 同伴标准下的开放参与
issue: 团队页：“There are no restrictions on who can contribute or how you can contribute, other than peer standards.”；手册：“There is no qualification process”。开放参与与同行标准并存。

title: 决定权与协作的张力
issue: 手册：“The DragonFly development model is loose; changes to the code are generally peer-reviewed… There is no formal entry/rejection process, though final say on all code submissions goes to Matt Dillon, as originator of this project.” 最终决定权与同行评审并行而程序未成文，题旨有据。

title: 内部权力与法人权力的分界
issue: 基金会：“managing contracts, licenses, and other agreements on its behalf”；项目侧核心团队“deciding the project’s overall goals and direction”。合同与许可归法人、技术决策归项目，权力分轨。

title: 内部技术权力的行使主体
issue: 行政页核心团队条目：“responsible for deciding the project’s overall goals and direction as well as managing specific areas”；portmgr、srcmgr、doceng、re、secteam 各设章程与领域。整体目标与领域执行分层。

title: 双轨权力的交汇点
issue: 已查行政页、捐赠页与基金会董事页：行政页“Core Team Liaison”系核心团队对安全、集群、发布工程等技术团队的联络，非基金会席位；捐赠页仅设 Donations Liaison Office（捐赠与财务对口）；基金会董事页无“核心团队联络”职位。未见“法人事务经常设席位进入项目议程”的一手表述。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：交汇席位无一手，题面改缺口〕

title: 法人权力的边界所在
issue: NetBSD 基金会页以列举定职权：“owns several of the NetBSD Project servers… handles donations… and administers NetBSD copyrights”；FreeBSD 基金会同以合同、许可、协议为其职掌。官方未明文写“不介入代码取舍”，该否定系由职权列举反推。

title: 团队章程与核心团队批准
issue: portmgr 页：团队章程“Discusses the goals, rights, and responsibilities of the team. The contents of this document are approved by the FreeBSD Core Team.” 章程须经核心团队批准，自治在上级框架内。

title: 领域自治的范围划定
issue: Committer’s Guide 第 4 节：“When FreeBSD commit bits are allocated, the areas of the tree where the bit may be used are specified.”；跨领域须“seeking approval from the appropriate entity”。领域划界与跨界另取权限均见原文。

title: 整体控制的手段清单
issue: ASF：“The board can to terminate a PMC at any time by resolution.”（原文含“can to”衍字，逐字引）；董事会另掌“management of the corporate assets… and allocation of corporate resources to projects”。终止权落点明确。

title: 自治失效的回收路径
issue: Committer’s Guide：“Only a 2/3 majority of core has the authority to suspend commit privileges for longer than a week or to remove them permanently.”；个人核心成员仅可临时中止，待全体复核。权限回收以表决为要件。

title: 规模差异下的治理模型
issue: Open Source Guides：“Smaller projects are probably BDFL by default, because there are only one or two maintainers.” 规模决定默认治理，小项目归领袖制。

title: 小项目的默认领袖制
issue: 同页 BDFL 条：“one person (usually the initial author of the project) has final say on all major project decisions”；并以上句“only one or two maintainers”释其成因。

title: 大项目的委员会分层
issue: 同页：“If your project has a very active contributor community, you might form a ‘core team’ of maintainers, or even subcommittees of people who take ownership of different issue areas.” 共同体扩大与委员会分层对应。

title: 治理文档的书写时点
issue: 同页：“There is no right time to write down your project’s governance, but it’s much easier to define once you’ve seen your community dynamics play out.” 补写而非预设。

title: 维护者的身份界定
issue: 同页：“A maintainer doesn’t necessarily have to be someone who writes code for your project.”；并称维护者“feels responsibility over the direction of the project”。

title: 独裁标签的实际含义
issue: 第 4 章：“The potential for forks is the reason there are no true dictators in free software projects.”；并称 forkability“puts an upper limit on how much power anyone can exert”。独裁标签受可分叉性约束。

title: 民主在重要决策上的实态
issue: 同章：“even projects that are not formally organized as democracies are, in practice, democracies when it comes to important decisions.” 逐字对应。

title: 集中与共识的边界
issue: ASF：“Apache projects are managed using a collaborative, consensus-based process.”；同页“the appointed PMCs have the power to create their own self-governing rules”。共识管理与委员会自定规则并列。

title: 概念标签的误用与限度
issue: 题属概念辨析，无年代、人数、机构等外部断言。所据同页反谓三类模型“have more in common than they seem”“Every model has advantages and trade-offs”，即标签易夸大差异；题下论旨“会掩盖项目间的实际差异”方向相反，宜并提“既夸大差异亦掩盖共性”。

title: 三类结构的参照系
issue: 同页：“There are three common governance structures associated with open source projects.”，下分 BDFL、Meritocracy、Liberal contribution 三型并逐一界定。
